makkah.title: Masjid al-Haram
makkah.description: The Great Mosque of Mecca, surrounding the Holy Kaaba. It is the holiest site in Islam.
makkah.significance: Contains the Kaaba, Maqam Ibrahim, and Zamzam Well.

makkah.title: Jabal al-Nour (Cave of Hira)
makkah.description: The mountain housing the Cave of Hira, where Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) received the first revelation.
makkah.significance: Site of the first revelation of the Quran.

makkah.title: Jabal Thawr
makkah.description: The mountain containing the cave where Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and Abu Bakr (RA) hid from the Quraish.

makkah.title: Mina
makkah.description: The city of tents where pilgrims stay during Hajj.

makkah.title: Arafat
makkah.description: The plain where pilgrims stand on the 9th of Dhul Hijjah.
makkah.significance: The most critical pillar of Hajj.

makkah.title: Masjid Aisha (Al-Tan'im)
makkah.description: The nearest Miqat for people inside Makkah to enter Ihram for Umrah.

madinah.title: Al-Masjid an-Nabawi
madinah.description: The Prophet's Mosque, the second holiest site in Islam.
madinah.significance: Contains the Prophet's (PBUH) grave and Rawdah.

madinah.title: Masjid Quba
madinah.description: The first mosque built in Islam by Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
madinah.significance: Prayer here equals the reward of an Umrah.

madinah.title: Mount Uhud
madinah.description: Site of the Battle of Uhud and the martyrs' cemetery.
madinah.significance: Historical battle site and graveyard of Hamza (RA).

madinah.title: Masjid al-Qiblatayn
madinah.description: The mosque where the direction of prayer (Qibla) was changed from Jerusalem to Makkah.
